Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jake the Snake <Rus...@mindspring.com> wrote:
> I always thought there was a 4 per card limit in deckmaster games...
> Am I wrong? Can I put 9 Blurs in my Brujah deck, etc.?
>
> What is the limit? Is there one?

There is no limit. You can have 9 Blurs in your Brujah deck, sure.

There are no overriding "deckmaster" rules for all deckmaster games
(unless you count the ability/impetus to trade and/or collect cards
as a "rule").

The limits to various deckmaster games come either from the rules of
that particular game or from rules presented by the DCI governing
tournament formats for a particular game.

Messages.Author: PDB6
Messages.Body:
Jake wrote:
"I always thought there was a 4 per card limit in deckmaster games...
Am I wrong? Can I put 9 Blurs in my Brujah deck, etc.?

What is the limit? Is there one?"

There is no limit of cards per deck. There is a maximum deck size (40 +10 per
player in the game, 90 max in tournies), but you can have a deck of 90
Chainsaws if you want.

Jyhad was designed _specifically_ to work without card limits, as Garfield saw
the problem with Magic (which required a CL to be imposed for game balance), so
he made Jyhad to work if you had all the card in the world, thus, no card
limit.
